vision.title: Connecting South Asian Growers to the World
paragraphs: Network71’s Agriculture Division was founded on a single conviction: the extraordinary agricultural wealth of South Asia remains underserved by modern global trade infrastructure. We exist to change that.

By embedding directly within farming communities — building trust, providing training, and offering fair pricing before a single crop is planted — we create supply chains that are genuinely sustainable rather than extractive.

Our processing hubs, cold-chain logistics, and direct export relationships mean that when a buyer in Dubai or Rotterdam sources from Network71, they can trace every batch back to a named district, a documented farming practice, and a farmer who earned a fair margin.

overview.title: A Diversified Platform for What Comes Next
overview.p1: Network71 grows in two ways: by strengthening each operating division, and by creating new businesses where an opportunity, a partner and the group's capabilities meet. The International Business & Strategic Ventures division owns the second path.
overview.p2: It evaluates opportunities across industries, structures joint ventures and strategic partnerships, and leads international expansion — so that the whole ecosystem, not just one division, benefits from every new market we enter.

principles.title: Aligned Incentives
principles.desc: We only enter structures where partners win together — shared upside, shared accountability.

principles.title: Operational Depth
principles.desc: Every venture is backed by the group's divisions, not just capital. Manufacturing, trade, tech and media resources are on call.

principles.title: Governance First
principles.desc: Clear boards, reporting lines and decision rights from the start. No ambiguity in ownership or control.

principles.title: Long-term Horizon
principles.desc: We build businesses to last. Short-term arbitrage is not our model.

models.title: Six Ways to Build Together
models.lead: From co-owned operating companies to market-entry programmes, each structure is chosen to fit the opportunity — never the other way round.

items.title: Joint Ventures
items.desc: Co-owned operating companies with aligned partners — shared capital, shared governance, and a clear operating plan from day one.

items.title: Strategic Partnerships
items.desc: Long-term commercial alliances — distribution, sourcing, technology or market-access agreements that extend both partners' reach.

items.title: Market Entry
items.desc: Structured expansion of Network71 divisions into new countries: regulatory mapping, local partners, entity setup and launch support.

items.title: Growth Investment
items.desc: Minority or majority positions in businesses that complement the ecosystem — with operational support rather than passive capital.

items.title: Trade Corridors
items.desc: Bilateral business platforms connecting Bangladesh with the Middle East, Europe, East Asia and Africa across multiple divisions.

items.title: Incubation & Spin-outs
items.desc: New ventures born inside the group — validated, resourced and spun out as independent businesses when they are ready.

process.title: Opportunity Screening
process.desc: Sector fit, market size, partner credibility and alignment with the wider Network71 ecosystem.

process.title: Due Diligence
process.desc: Commercial, financial, legal and reputational review before any commitment is made.

process.title: Structure & Terms
process.desc: JV, partnership or investment structure; governance, capital plan and exit provisions.

process.title: Formation
process.desc: Entity setup, regulatory approvals, banking and operating agreements.

process.title: Launch & Operate
process.desc: Management team, shared services from the group and quarterly performance reviews.

process.title: Scale
process.desc: Expansion into new products, geographies or adjacent divisions once fundamentals are proven.

partners.title: Partners Who Want to Build, Not Just Transact

items.desc: Creating quality employment across all ten divisions, with fair wages, safe conditions, and career development pathways for our people.

items.title: Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure
items.desc: Investing in modern manufacturing infrastructure and digital platforms like Ezyify to drive industrial innovation across Bangladesh and beyond.

items.title: Responsible Consumption & Production
items.desc: Reducing waste, adopting circular economy practices, and sourcing raw materials from verified responsible suppliers.

items.title: Climate Action
items.desc: Committed to reducing our carbon footprint through renewable energy investment, emissions tracking, and science-based reduction targets.

items.title: Partnerships for the Goals
items.desc: Collaborating with NGOs, government bodies, and international organisations to amplify sustainable development outcomes in our communities.

items.title: Net Zero by 2040

items.title: Responsible Sourcing

items.title: Transparency & Reporting

hero.title: Our Journey
hero.lead: From Dhaka to the World — seven years of growth, diversification, and relentless ambition.

entries.title: Foundation
entries.desc: Network71 established in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Began with trading operations, laying the groundwork for a diversified global enterprise.

entries.title: First Manufacturing Facility
entries.desc: Opened our first manufacturing facility, accelerating production capacity and establishing Network71 as a credible industrial operator.

entries.title: Multi-Sector Portfolio
entries.desc: Added Food & Beverage and Oils & Energy divisions, building a resilient multi-sector portfolio and diversified revenue base.

entries.title: Five Divisions Established
entries.desc: Expanded to five business divisions including IT & Software — beginning the technology transformation that would define our next chapter.

entries.title: International Scale
entries.desc: Trade network extended across the Middle East, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with new export and sourcing relationships.

entries.title: Ezyify AI Platform Launched
entries.desc: Launched Ezyify — an AI-powered global e-commerce and social media ecosystem. A landmark step in our technology-led growth strategy.

entries.title: Today
entries.desc: Ten business divisions — including Media, Ship Marketplace and Strategic Ventures — operating from Dhaka with trade partners across South Asia, the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
